onNoTags.description:
OnNoTags decides what happens when the selected scenarios have no tags:
"fallback" (start all enabled apps, default) or "error".

dir.description: Dir is the working directory, relative to axx.yaml.

oneOf.description: command line, split into words without a shell unless shell: true

command.description:
Command starts the app: a string (split like a shell word list, without
a shell) or an argv list. Set shell: true to run it through the shell.

shell.description: Shell runs command and cleanup through /bin/sh -c (cmd /C on Windows).

dependsOn.description: DependsOn names apps that must be ready first.

tcp.description: TCP is a host:port that must accept connections.

oneOf.description: command line, split into words without a shell unless shell: true

exec.description: Exec is a command that must exit 0.

log.description: Log is a regular expression matched against the app's output.

timeout.description: Timeout for the app to become ready. Default: 60s.

signal.description: Signal sent first: SIGTERM (default) or SIGINT.

grace.description: Grace period before the process group is killed. Default: 10s.

oneOf.description: command line, split into words without a shell unless shell: true

cleanup.description: Cleanup runs after the app stops, even if it crashed.

oneOf.description: command line, split into words without a shell unless shell: true

command.description: Command replaces the normal command in debug mode.

mode.description:
Mode is "ide-listens" (the IDE listens and the app connects, e.g. JDWP
server=n; default for java) or "app-listens" (delve, --inspect, debugpy).

onUnavailable.description:
OnUnavailable decides what happens when the debugger is not listening:
fail, fallback (run the normal command) or retry (default).

additionalProperties.description: App is an application or piece of infrastructure managed by axx.

name.description: Name is shown in check output.

filePatterns.description: FilePatterns are globs (relative to baseDir) of the files to validate.

schemaType.description:
SchemaType is the family whose oracle validates the files: avro,
json, yaml, xml, protobuf or dataset.

schemaRef.description:
SchemaRef is the schema, relative to baseDir (unlike factory.schema,
which is relative to the factory file).

FixtureConformance.description: FixtureConformance validates matched files against a schema.

emit.description:
Emit writes one cross-file-unique lint rule per declared identity.
Default: true.

output.description:
Output is the generated rules file, relative to baseDir. Default:
axx-lint.generated.yaml. Wire it in with lint.include.

FixtureLint.description: FixtureLint configures the generated lint rules.

ignored.description:
Ignored makes outputs gitignored derivations instead of committed
files: the tool maintains exact .gitignore entries and `axx fixtures
generate` materializes them. Default: false.

baseDir.description:
BaseDir is the resource root every fixtures path resolves against,
relative to axx.yaml. Default: the directory of axx.yaml.

factories.description:
Factories are globs (relative to baseDir) locating factory specs.
Default: ["**.factory.yaml"].

sources.description:
Sources are additional roots, relative to baseDir ("../" reaches
outside it), walked for factory, prototype and fixture sources exactly
like baseDir, so fixtures can sit next to generated files that live
elsewhere (a compose-mounted WireMock directory, say). Roots must
exist and be disjoint from baseDir and each other.

conformance.description:
Conformance rules validate files no factory manages through a
family's schema oracle.

lint.description: Lint configures the lint rules generated from identity declarations.

output.description:
Output holds module-wide output defaults; factories override them
with factory.output.

Fixtures.description: Fixtures configures `axx fixtures`, the fixture factory: *.factory.yaml, *.fixture.yaml and *.prototype.yaml sources expanded into schema-governed fixture files, with the ownership manifest, drift and conformance checks.

include.description:
Include lists rule files merged into this section (for example the
axx-lint.generated.yaml written by `axx fixtures generate`), resolved
relative to the including file. Included files contribute rules and
further includes only; they must not have a config block.

config.description: Config holds the settings shared by every rule.

rules.description: Rules are the isolation rules, run in order (included rules follow).

Lint.description: Lint configures `axx lint`: test-data isolation rules.

baseDir.description:
BaseDir is the directory file patterns are resolved against, relative
to axx.yaml. Default: the directory of axx.yaml.

mode.description:
Mode is "error" (violations make `axx lint` exit 3, default) or "warn"
(violations are reported but do not fail).

maxFileSize.description:
MaxFileSize skips files larger than this many bytes, with a warning.
Default: 5242880 (5 MB).

maxReportedValues.description:
MaxReportedValues is how many duplicate values the human output lists
per rule before truncating. Default: 3. Machine formats list all.

maxReportedLocations.description:
MaxReportedLocations is how many locations the human output lists per
duplicate value before truncating. Default: 5. Machine formats list all.

LintConfig.description: LintConfig holds the settings shared by every lint rule.

name.description: Name identifies the rule in reports.

description.description: Description says why the values must be unique; shown with violations.

filePatterns.description:
FilePatterns are glob patterns (Java glob syntax: *, **, ?, [abc],
{a,b}) selecting the files to scan, relative to baseDir. The part
before the first wildcard is a directory (it may start with ../); the
rest is matched against the end of each file path below it, so
"seeds/*.yaml" also finds YAML files in subdirectories of seeds.

excludePatterns.description:
ExcludePatterns are glob patterns removing files from the match set,
matched against the whole path relative to baseDir; ** crosses
directories, e.g. "**.fixture.yaml".

type.description:
Type is "regex" (default: extract values with regex) or "jsonpath"
(parse each file as JSON and extract the values at jsonPath).

regex.description:
Regex is a Java regular expression, applied in MULTILINE mode (^ and $
match at line boundaries). Each match contributes the text of its
first participating capture group.

jsonPath.description:
JSONPath selects the values of a jsonpath rule, e.g. "order.id",
"payments[*].id" or "$.items[0].sku" (exact field paths with array
indexes or [*]); other JSONPath expressions ("$..id", filters) are
evaluated like Jayway JsonPath. Only scalar values count.

validation.description:
Validation is "global-unique" (default: a value may occur once),
"file-unique" (no repeats within a file; files may share values) or
"cross-file-unique" (repeats within one file are fine; no two files
may share a value).

mode.description: Mode overrides config.mode for this rule: "error" or "warn".

ignoreValues.description: IgnoreValues are values never reported (intentionally shared constants).

LintRule.description: LintRule is one test-data isolation rule.

OpenAPI.description: OpenAPI holds default validation levels, keyed by validation message key (e.g.

paths.description: Paths are feature files or directories. Default: ["features"].

tags.description: Tags is a default tag expression, e.g. "not @wip".

workers.description:
Workers is the number of scenarios run in parallel: a number or "auto"
(number of CPUs). Default: auto.

exclusive.description: Exclusive lists tags whose scenarios run alone, after the parallel phase.

Timeouts.description: Timeouts bound steps, scenarios and hooks.

version.description: Schema version of this file. Currently 1.

run.description: Run controls which features run and how.

resources.description:
Resources are directories that relative resource paths in steps (seed
files, schemas, payloads) resolve against, in order. The directory of
axx.yaml is always searched last.

properties.description: Properties back ${sys:name} references. `-D name=value` overrides them.

openapi.description: OpenAPI holds default OpenAPI validation settings for REST services.

active.description: Active starts only the applications needed by the selected scenarios.

apps.description:
Apps are the applications under test (and their infrastructure),
started before scenarios run and stopped afterwards, in declaration order.

packs.description: Packs holds pack settings keyed by pack name.

lint.description:
Lint configures `axx lint`: test-data isolation rules that keep values
such as seed ids unique so scenarios can run in parallel.

profiles.description: Profiles are named overlays selected with --profile or AXX_PROFILE.

title: axx.yaml
description: Configuration for axx, the human-readable acceptance testing framework (https://axx.nimbusxr.us).
